trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy in the game and this unlocks automatically — there is no shortcut. Work through the story, the activities, the collectibles and the combat challenges below, and use the filters on this page to see what is left. PowerPyx puts a full run at roughly 200 hours.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'Gone Fishing'. It unlocks through normal play with no special setup. Story missions cannot be replayed, so keep the 15 manual save slots in rotation (as PowerPyx recommends) before big story beats, in case a one-time moment is missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock automatically as the story advances — nothing optional is needed, just play the chapter to its end.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like all chapter trophies it unlocks automatically when the chapter's final mission ends — no side content is required.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. The trophy pops when the chapter closes; keep playing the story and it comes on its own.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. One chapter from the end of the story — the trophy unlocks when the chapter's final mission is done.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story, at the end of Chapter 5. No choice made earlier changes this — finish the story and the gold trophy pops with the credits.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'Breakfast Run'. Mission trophies unlock on completion with no extra objective — play the mission through to its end.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'The Cartel Heist'. A big set-piece mission — complete it and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'Child's Play'. Complete the mission and the trophy unlocks automatically.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'Headliners'. Complete the mission to its end and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'VCIA Takedown'. Complete the airport takedown mission and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'Operation Savage Glory'. Complete the mission and the trophy is earned.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The in-game stats screen tracks what counts — story, activities, collectibles and challenges. This is the long grind of the platinum: clear everything else first, then use this guide's checklist to find what is left. Cheats disable trophies, so play clean.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps and aerial tricks — the counter rises as you land them across Leonida. Farm them in free roam with fast bikes and ramps. Which stunt types count is not independently confirmed, so watch the in-game counter as you play.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type once — races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, the shooting range, drone races and the rest. One attempt each is enough; you do not need to win. The activity list in-game shows which types you have not tried yet.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. There are 42 Shooting Range challenges in total. Gold needs speed and accuracy — learn each range's layout, then chase gold one challenge at a time.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of its locations. Drone races are a listed activity; winning at every location is required, so revisit any location where you placed lower than first.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, but each race only counts once — variety matters more than repetition. Work through the race list across Leonida.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges run at fishing spots and Cal is the rival angler. Win the challenge against him. Which spot hosts Cal is not independently confirmed — check the PowerPyx guide before hunting him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Find an arcade machine in Leonida, start any game, and play it to completion. Any arcade game counts.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's strand. Stranger mission strands unlock as you explore and progress the story; finish Andy's chain to the end and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's strand. Work through Kenton's missions as they appear and finish the chain.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's strand. Finish Billy's mission chain to the end.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers appear as you explore; each strand is a short mission chain. Eight completed strands unlock this — keep taking stranger missions whenever they appear on the map.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's strand. Finish Randy's mission chain to the end.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's strand. Finish Tyrone's mission chain to the end.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — the game's one potentially missable trophy, per PowerPyx. Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. One spot is at Jason's house and is only available after the mission 'Down to Earth', when Lucia is on the balcony — choose 'Accept' when prompted. Do it before advancing the story past that point; there is no mission replay. The full spot list is not independently confirmed, so check PowerPyx before finishing the story.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand gives you the target — track it, hunt it, and bring it back. Which animal and where it spawns is not independently confirmed — check the cited guides first.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida; each set needs all of its cards. Collect them in free roam and track your sets in the collection menu.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the in-game photo and sharing feature — use it at 100 distinct spots across the map. The counter tracks distinct locations, so keep moving to new places.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges cover stunts, combat, driving and more, and are tracked in-game. Work through the challenge list; 50 completions unlock this on the way to 100%.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level while playing with your partner, then escape the heat. Get to 4 stars with your partner alongside, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the wanted level clears.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row while the wanted level stays active — plan a route of nearby shops and keep moving between them.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Driving or entering a new vehicle model adds it to the discovered list. Variety counts — try different classes across Leonida rather than the same cars over and over.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Find a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and chain five takedowns before it ends. Crowded shootouts are the best chance.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). Steal or board a plane at the airport and take off without a scheduled flight — the trophy pops once you are airborne. Which aircraft or runway is not independently confirmed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Get into a Rhino tank and stir up trouble — survive the heat it draws. Exactly what triggers it is not independently confirmed; check the PowerPyx guide before attempting it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — avoid cameras and guards, take the goods, and leave before any alarm. If you are spotted the attempt fails; leave and try again.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vault robberies are multi-stage — crack the vault, grab the cash, and escape the wanted level. Five successful escapes unlock this.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush a truck, take its cash, and lose the wanted level. Trucks run routes across Leonida — watch for them in traffic.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every district and region until the map is fully revealed. Driving and flying across the state fills the map in; check the map screen for dark areas left to visit.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Each gang runs illegal operations across Leonida — hit one per gang. How many gangs there are and where their operations sit is not independently confirmed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a bar or spot with an ocean view on Ocean Beach and order a cocktail. A quiet moment trophy — it pops when the scene triggers.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom front — pick a showroom, build speed inside, and crash out through the glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go bowling there and complete a game — the follow-through is the trigger. Any completed game at that alley counts.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This relates to building your partnership's reputation — raise it through shared activities with your partner. Which action triggers it is not independently confirmed; check the cited guides.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Story choices throughout the game feed this — it unlocks as your decisions accumulate. Play naturally through the story; it cannot be forced early.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Something failed once, then worked the second time — a retry-based trophy. Which activity it ties to is not independently confirmed; see the cited guides.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? An odd, hidden moment in Leonida — the description gives nothing away. Where it triggers is not independently confirmed; check PowerPyx and Exophase before hunting it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon and knock your targets down like pins — line them up and bowl them over in one pass. How many targets one pass needs is not independently confirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — launder them through contacts to clean the cash. $250,000 laundered in total unlocks this.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food, cars — every shop purchase counts toward the total. It accumulates across the whole game.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Garages are bought across Leonida — each one needs cash, so this is a late-game purchase once money is flowing. The property menu lists them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the app to register vehicles you find — ten registrations unlock this. Any vehicles count.
